mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for the FEDFUNDS decline signal is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return in declining rate periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts exceed 1450 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1450, or the Rank IC for the HOUST signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in monthly payrolls signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling) fails to produce negative returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0, the decline in UNRATE does not lead to positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly industrial production exceeds 105 (index, 2017=100), it signals robust manufacturing and supply chain activity, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 325) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 325) fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly retail sales exceed 750,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 750,000, or the Rank IC for the RSAFS signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 23750 billion dollars, it signals robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 23750, or the Rank IC for the GDPC1 signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
